title: Evaluation of early administration of Levetiracetam in the prevention and treatment of delirium during septic shock: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. KiSS
official: Evaluation of early administration of Levetiracetam in the prevention and treatment of delirium during septic shock: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. KiSS
summary: Main objective: To assess the impact of early 7-day administration of levetiracetam in patients with septic shock hospitalized in the ICU on the number of days alive without coma or delirium at D14.
conditions: Adult ICU patients with septic shock

interventions.name: LEVETIRACETAM VIATRIS 100 mg/ml, solution à diluer pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. age ≥18 years
2. hospitalized in intensive care for less than 96 hours  with septic shock evolving for less than 24 hours, defined by : o a clinically or microbiologically documented infection  and o a SOFA score ≥2 or an increase in SOFA ≥2 points if organ dysfunction was present prior to infection and o the need for vasopressor administration to maintain a mean arterial pressure ≥65mmHg and o lactatemia > 2mmol/L (18mg/dL) despite adequate vascular filling
3. consent of patient, family member or inclusion in emergency situation without prior consent of patient or family member
Exclusion criteria:
1. Chronic long-term antiepileptic treatment upon admission or patient with uncontrolled seizures
2. Patients with Chronic or progressive central neurological pathologies of traumatic, inflammatory, vascular, infectious, neoplastic or degenerative origin, defined by cognitive impairment not allowing independent living or an IQCODE score > 4.5
3. Patients with Severe head injury less than 3 months old
4. Patients in a situation where active therapies are limited, or for whom the therapeutic commitment is not maximal
5. Patients with Allergy to levetiracetam
6. Minor patients
7. Patients with Pregnancy in progress (bHCG blood or urine)
8. Patients with limitations on life-sustaining therapies  or for whom therapeutic commitment is not maximal
9. Chronic or progressive central neurological pathologies of traumatic, inflammatory, vascular, infectious, neoplastic, or degenerative origin, defined by cognitive impairments preventing independent living or an IQCODE score > 4.5
10. Severe head trauma within the past 3 months
11. Nursing mothers
12. Patient under guardianship or trusteeship
13. Patient with moderate to severe dementia
14. Patients presenting with signs of depression and/or suicidal ideation or suicidal behavior and/or a history of suicide attempt(s)
15. Patient With a prolonged QTc interval on ECG and/or any of the high arrhythmic-risk cardiovascular conditions defined below: •	Congenital or acquired long QT syndrome (QTc ≥ 470 ms in males, ≥ 480 ms in females) or a history of torsades de pointes; • Documented history of sustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, or arrhythmia-related cardiac arrest; • Inherited cardiac disease associated with a high risk of arrhythmia (including arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy, Brugada syndrome, and channelopathies); • Severe unstable heart failure (unstable NYHA class III–IV or recent decompensation).
16. Concomitant treatment with Methotrexate during the administration of the investigational treatment
17. Patients Not affiliated to a social security scheme or CMU
18. Patientswho Participate in another interventional trial with a drug that could interact with levetiracetam or have an impact on the evaluation of the KiSS trial endpoints. In case of doubt, please contact the trial coordinating investigator.
